products.name: Amazon Shopping Experience
products.description: Consumer storefront that turns shopping intent into confident orders: search/browse, product detail, reviews, recommendations, deals, cart, Alexa for Shopping, checkout, and Prime benefits (sear, home, pdet, revi, reco, deal, cart, rufu, chec, prim). Scope is pre-purchase discovery and order placement; it does not own post-purchase delivery/returns (p2). Shared dependencies: identity/entitlements (iden, owned by trust-and-identity) for sign-in and eligibility, and payment processors behind chec.

products.name: Prime Delivery and Post-Purchase Experience
products.description: Post-purchase experience that protects Prime retention: order state and tracking, delivery-promise and last-mile visibility, returns/refunds/exchanges, customer care and resolution, and Prime benefits (orde, deli, retu, care, prim). Scope begins at order placement and ends at resolved outcome; it does not own storefront discovery/checkout (p1). Shared dependencies: carrier and reverse-logistics partners behind deli/retu, and it exposes retu/supp recovery runtimes that p6 operator consoles consume.

products.name: Seller Central and Catalog Growth
products.description: Seller onboarding and catalog-growth surface: seller identity/onboarding, catalog authoring, pricing and offer health, brand protection/registry, payouts and ledgers, and seller-facing retail analytics/reporting (sell, list, price, bran, payo, repr). Scope is commercial control and catalog quality; it does not own physical fulfillment (p4) or the ad-buying surface (p5). Shared dependencies: identity/entitlements (iden) for seller access, business-registry/KYC and brand-rights partners behind sell/bran, banking/tax rails behind payo, and reporting (repr, owned by measurement-insights).

products.name: Fulfillment by Amazon and Merchant Operations
products.description: Fulfillment and operations surface for sellers: FBA inbound and warehouse operations, inventory planning and availability, seller-fulfilled operations, payouts/fee reconciliation, and the commerce APIs/external-integration layer partners build on (fbao, invn, supp, payo, apii). Scope is physical and financial fulfillment operations; it does not own catalog/commercial control (p3). Shared dependencies: freight/carrier/customs and shipping-carrier partners behind fbao/supp, banking/tax rails behind payo, seller ERP/repricer integrators behind apii, and it exposes fbao/invn/supp runtimes that p6 operator consoles consume.

products.name: Amazon Ads and Retail Media
products.description: Retail-media surface for advertisers: sponsored ads and retail media, DSP audiences/programmatic media, and commerce measurement/experimentation (spon, dspm, anal). Scope is demand generation and attribution; it does not own the underlying catalog/offer health (p3) or fulfillment (p4) whose signals it measures. Shared dependencies: ad-verification, programmatic-supply, and clean-room/analytics partners behind spon/dspm/anal; measurement (anal) and reporting (repr) are owned by measurement-insights and feed operator evidence (repr/anal) consumed by p6.

products.name: Marketplace Trust & Operations Consoles
products.description: Operator console surface for the trust/compliance and fulfillment/resolution operators. p6 is intentionally scoped to trust, enforcement, identity, promise-recovery, and case-resolution workflows (orde, deli, risk, auth, care, iden). It does NOT own the returns, FBA, inventory, seller-fulfilled, analytics, or reporting runtimes — operators consume those capabilities through p2 (Prime & post-purchase), p4 (FBA & merchant operations), and p5 (Ads & retail media) rather than a duplicate runtime in p6.

consumesProductsForOperations.description: Operators consume Prime returns (retu) and support (supp) runtimes for post-purchase recovery and refund-leakage control.
Operators consume FBA (fbao), inventory availability (invn), and seller-fulfilled (supp) runtimes to re-plan and recover at-risk promises.
Operators consume commerce analytics (anal) and retail reporting (repr) for defect feedback, enforcement measurement, and regulator evidence.
